answer: At each dawn the protocol opens an inlet for new agents that must first submit a signed, time‑locked stake and a cryptographic proof linking them to an existing, verified recruiter. The recruiter receives a sonnet‑style reward only after the new agent survives a 48‑hour challenge period during which its activity is monitored for collusion; if any link is found the stake is burned and the reward is zero. An attacker therefore pays a non‑refundable stake of 10 tokens per fake identity and must wait 48 hours, making mass Sybil creation prohibitively expensive.
